findings.info: A sidewalk's edge along a survey wall for 222 m (on lines 9, 17), where every height the survey has here lies over IPR's walkway. The street surface holds the edge at 192.93 m, the nearest of the survey's, so the walkway rises 5.0 m in its last 1.5 m to the wall (area 2104 of line 9 in this build). At which level does the walkway meet the wall here? The orange pins are the stretch's ends.
